item.title: Build Artifacts and Cache in Jenkins
item.description: In a CICD flow, there are two main kinds of things that need to be saved: build artifacts and caches. Build artifacts are the final execution result, and caches exist to speed up the next build. This post mainly describes how to archive build artifacts and caches in Jenkins, along with a hands-on example backed by object storage.
